name: Trigyn Technologies Limited
summary: Trigyn Technologies Limited provides communications and information technology staffing support services in India and internationally. The company provides cloud and infrastructure, Medicaid MMIS, SAP, data and artificial intelligence, development and maintenance, digital learning and transformation, smart cities and IoT, vaccination management, and staffing and consulting services, as well as blockchain solutions. It serves BFSI, education, government, healthcare, IGO, and security and surveillance industries. The company was formerly known as Leading Edge Systems Ltd and changed its name to Trigyn Technologies Limited in July 2000. Trigyn Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
